subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult assassin in <Picture 1>: long silver-white hair, brown eyes, red-black eye-mask face paint, exposed red lips, black-red tactical suit, silver shoulder and forearm armor, gloves, belts, knee guards and heavy boots. Preserve her identity, paint and equipment; weapons remain holstered.
<Subject 2> is the adult woman in <Picture 2>: silver chin-length bob with pale-blue tips, light eyes, angular earrings, charcoal blazer, white top, black high-waisted trousers and block-heel ankle boots. Preserve her face, hair and tailoring. Both sheets provide character appearances rather than literal starting frames.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second, 16:9 ruined-city action-comedy among thorns and electrical cables. <Subject 1> presses in close; <Subject 2> escapes through obstacles and counters from a wrecked car. Praise of R佬's workflow becomes a marriage rivalry. Eight shots build to a leaping kick, armored block and opposing recoveries. R佬 stays off-screen.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 8]): fully_preserved - retain her face, long silver hair, eye paint, armor and costume through action and emotional changes.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 8]): fully_preserved - retain her face, blue-tipped bob, earrings, blazer and trousers through action and emotional changes.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic action-comedy, exactly 15 seconds. Eight shots; cut at 00:01.100, 00:02.700, 00:04.200, 00:08.000, 00:10.100, 00:12.000 and 00:13.300. Camera positions change with the fight's advantage and momentum. Use close moving foregrounds, clear contact views, brief reaction space and a wide final action payoff.

Gutted buildings, exposed rebar and wrecked cars surround an abandoned junction. Hooked thorn vines choke balconies and split paving. Electrical cables sag from broken poles and facades. Grey daylight, dusty amber backlight and soft fill reveal silver hair, eyes and mouths.

A dusty corridor runs between a tiled pier at rear right and a low wrecked car at rear left. Thorns block the pier's far side; a chest-height cable crosses its approach. Cable ends hang beside the supported car hood. Keep landmarks, debris and trails consistent; bodies use real gaps.

[Shot 1] A ground-skimming wide shot begins on <Subject 1>'s boot kicking grit backward. She accelerates from left toward <Subject 2> retreating at right. Track beside their legs, then tilt into a moving full-body two-shot. Hair and coat hems trail. Cut as her shoulder launches the strike, carrying left-to-right pressure forward.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.100, cut to a lateral medium two-shot. The forearm strike hits the raised guard; show contact and recoil together. Shoulder compresses, torso yields and back foot scrapes. Retreat with the impact. A second straight strike drives the defender toward the pier.

The suited woman's gaze checks the thorns behind her. She redirects the strike with one palm, steps outside it and lowers her head toward the opening under the cable. Cut while the attacking arm passes her shoulder; the next view inherits its speed and direction.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.700, cut low and wide from the pier side, revealing obstacle and exit. The suited woman folds beneath the cable, slips diagonally clear and pulls the attacking forearm along its momentum. The assassin crosses a recovery step toward the pier. Slide sideways past foreground thorns to reveal the escape.

The assassin breaks the grip and converts recovery into an armored backhand. The rival ducks; the blow strikes the pier's cracked outer tiles. Small plates shear off, followed by brick crumbs and dust, leaving the thick core intact. Arm rebounds, shoulder twists and long hair lashes through backlight. A brushed cable swings after the bodies pass. Hold just enough to read the shattered edge, then cut with the falling debris.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.200, cut on recoil to <Subject 1> (S1) in tracking medium close-up. Her rival rises at the edge and pushes the armored upper arm, forcing a recovery step. Give ground and steady as she brakes. Dust and cables keep moving.

She exhales, brows lift and fierce eyes brighten into proud enthusiasm. In an assertive, slightly husky female Mandarin voice, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 感谢R佬整理工作流，速度快，质量好!</d> Pronounce R as the English letter name followed by 佬. Speak briskly and clearly, stressing speed and quality. Her glove briefly becomes a thumbs-up below her chin, then returns to guard. The face stays readable while hair and shoulders settle. Finish the sentence before the next cut; admiration grows naturally out of a breathless fight.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, cut to a reverse moving medium shot of <Subject 2> (S2). She circles toward the wrecked car, stepping between thorn roots and brick chips. Track laterally with her; bob and blazer bounce with the steps. One brow rises and an asymmetric smile challenges the rival.

In a clear, cooler female Mandarin voice, lighter than S1, <Subject 2> (S2) says, <d>[Chinese] 这么厉害，我嫁他!</d> She taps her chest below the neckline, glances toward the lens and plants her next step beside the car. The assassin's approaching glove enters the edge of frame. The suited woman's eyes snap toward it; cut on the impending interception.

[Shot 6] At 00:10.100, cut to <Subject 1> (S1) in medium close-up, completing the glove's motion into a shove against the rival's upper arm. Show the speaking face and resisting shoulder. Hair swings late after her head turn; brows tighten and eyes fix on the rival.

In the same husky voice, jealous and impatient, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 想得美，我先嫁!</d> Stress the final claim. The suited woman catches the wrist at the lower frame edge, turns out of the shove and backs toward the car hood. The assassin retracts and advances. Finish the line before the cut, with the physical challenge growing from the verbal claim.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.000, cut to a low wide view along the corridor. <Subject 2> places one boot on the low hood while <Subject 1> closes from the opposite side. Both briefly turn their faces toward the lens without abandoning their fight. <Subject 1> (S1) and <Subject 2> (S2) shout together, <d>[Chinese] R佬，选我!</d> The line is short and finishes before the launch.

The suited woman loads her knee on the hood and drives upward and forward, flexing the metal. Her other knee rises; the assassin lowers into a crossed-arm guard. Cut on takeoff, matching travel direction.

[Shot 8] At 00:13.300, cut to a wider lateral view containing car, both fighters and landing space. The suited woman travels in a compact forward leap from the hood, extends a front kick and meets the assassin's crossed armored guard. Keep launch path, contact and recoil readable in one shot. One hard impact compresses the guard toward the chest. The assassin's torso yields and boots skid through grit, throwing a low dust fan. The suited woman retracts her kicking leg and descends; blazer tails and blue hair tips continue forward.

Track the expanding separation with a short lateral pullback. The suited woman lands with bent knees on clear paving, palm briefly touching ground to absorb the descent. The assassin catches a heel against a pavement seam and drops into a low braced guard. Thorn silhouettes frame the foreground; neither woman lands inside the growth. End at 15 seconds on the completed landing and braking action, as both lift their eyes toward each other. Dust, hair, fabric, hood vibration and cables keep moving. The rivalry remains unresolved after a visible physical climax.

Preserve geography and fighting personalities: armored forward pressure versus evasive gaps and elevation. Shots inherit body state and momentum. Displacement enables counters; damage persists. Foreground obstacles provide depth while contact stays visible.

Generate Mandarin speech and articulation together: husky S1 belongs to the assassin, cooler S2 to the suited woman. Listening lips rest; lines finish before cuts. No source audio is supplied; shot windows specify pacing rather than phoneme alignment. Preserve identities and voices.

overall_soundscape:
Wind, cable creaks, boots, armor and cracked tiles form the street soundscape. Debris keeps falling. Hood flex, armored impact, landing slap and scrape follow contact. Mandarin voices stay forward with short street reflections; effects soften beneath speech.

non_diegetic_music:
Low drums, taut plucked strings and restrained metallic accents drive the opening. Thin out under praise, add a playful rising pulse to the marriage rivalry, then accent takeoff and final interception. Let landing, scrape and drifting debris remain audible at the end. Instrumental only.
